profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: Terre Haute, Indiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Courses:  CSSE230 Data Structures and Algorithms (Java), CSSE304 Programming Language Concepts(Scheme), CSSE120 Intro to Software Development(Python)
•	Taught students using a learning centered approach
•	Assisted professor with grading and individual student assistance
•	Maintained knowledge on subject matter and software
positions.insights: Skills: Software Testing · Problem Solving · Pycharm · Scheme · Interpersonal Communication · Pygame · Skill Development · Data Structures · Computer Science · Algorithms · Programming · Java · Attention to Detail · Python (Programming Language) · Dr. Racket · Programming Languages · Communication

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern, Key Web Front-End Team
positions.description:
•	Completed UX designs and front-end development for a secure delivery access point location accuracy feature on amazon.com and the Amazon Mobile app
•	Learned basic React and Typescript for project completion
•	Lead UX design critiques with visual designers
•	Held engineering design reviews for the front-end code and architecture
•	Demoed new feature successfully end-to-end to internship stakeholders
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Software Testing · Git · Problem Solving · Web Design · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Coding Standards · Responsive Web Design · Skill Development · Computer Science · Programming · User Experience (UX) · Attention to Detail · Figma · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Code Review · Programming Languages · Communication · React.js · User Interface Design · Self Learning · Teamwork

positions.title: UX/UI Pathway Intern
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with Bioinformatics Pathway to design a tangible and well-researched skill-development software by incorporating user research and design methods
•	Coordinated with teammates, project leads, and project managers to create a product
•	Generated an interactive Figma prototype to showcase the final product
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Web Design · Responsive Web Design · Skill Development · User Experience (UX) · Attention to Detail · Figma · Communication · User Interface Design · Self Learning · Teamwork

positions.title: Google Computer Science Summer Institute
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•	Expanded knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS using lectures and at-home work from Google instructors
•	Participated with peers and Google Advisors on 10 small projects over the first 3 weeks of program
•	Worked with two partners to build a water tracking web app using Glitch.com
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Google Docs · CSS · Problem Solving · Skill Development · Computer Science · Programming · HTML · Glitch.com · Programming Languages · Communication · Self Learning · Teamwork
